findings.note: TMS case ELITEA-2392 directs testers to a nonexistent 'Settings -> AI Configuration' page and describes tabs ('AI Configuration'/'OpenAI Template') that exist on a different page entirely, mislabelled. Filed as EliteaAI/elitea-testing-public#1250 with full repro + recommendation to retitle/rescope the case. Not a product defect - both surfaces work correctly as designed.

Vector Storage and AI Credentials sections on the AI Providers page render nothing (not even an empty state) when the project has zero configured items for that section - confirmed correct-by-design via ConfigurationSection.jsx source + live network capture (200, items:[]). Any future case touching these two sections needs either seeded test data or an API-response-based conditional assertion, never a bare visibility check.

Entire ai-providers component tree (AIProvidersContent.jsx, ConfigurationsPanel.jsx, ConfigurationSection.jsx, AIProviderAccordion.jsx, ConfigurationCard.jsx) had zero data-testid/testId usage before this case. DrawerPageHeader.jsx's missing titleTestId gap was already flagged by a prior analyst (settings-personal-tokens/_surface.md, ELITEA-2277) which named AIProviders as a pending consumer - still unaddressed for elements outside this test's touched scope.

Confirmed (not newly found) the analyst's case-identity clarification already filed as EliteaAI/elitea-testing-public#1250: the TMS case is titled "AI Configuration page loads all integration sections without error" and directs the tester to Settings -> AI Configuration, but no such page/nav-item exists in the live product. The described sections live on the sidebar item labelled "AI Providers" (/settings/ai-providers). Case step 12 / Expected Final State ("AI Configuration"/"OpenAI Template" tabs present at top) refers to a different page entirely (Settings -> General -> "AI Configurations" accordion, labelled "Basic"/"OpenAI Template" there) and is intentionally not automated.

Select.SingleSelect (src/[fsd]/shared/ui/select/SingleSelect.jsx) already accepts a caller-supplied data-testid prop and forwards it onto the underlying MUI Select plus a `${dataTestId}-combobox` variant via SelectDisplayProps -- no core-component change was needed to wire the Default/High-tier/Low-tier selector testids, only a JSX-side template derived from the already-threaded sectionTestId prop. Worth knowing for any future AI-providers-adjacent or other Select-using surface.

Non-blocking scope observation: ConfigurationSection.jsx (EliteaUI@5119ba70/ff547e50) derives a SECOND testid from the same required sectionTestId prop — `${sectionTestId}-default-selector` on the section's Select — gated by the pre-existing `hasDefaultSetting` prop, not by whether this test asserts it. Vector Storage has `hasDefaultSetting={true}`, so once that section ever carries real configured items, its default-selector testid activates whether or not a future case references it — a dormant-but-correctly-scoped derived testid, not an orphan.

The filed clarification issue #1250 (case names a nonexistent 'AI Configuration' page) carried no labels at filing time — profile.md marks `question` as a load-bearing label for parked-decision issues the factory must never pick up as a task. Flagged for a label sweep so it isn't accidentally worked as a task.

Mechanical self-check (role-overrides.md reviewer grep), run against the full PR diff (base tests/batch-elitea-2392-ai-configuration-page vs head tests/ELITEA-2392-ai-providers-page-sections-load-without-error): one hit, `self.page.locator(self.CONFIGURATION_CARD_SELECTOR)`, where CONFIGURATION_CARD_SELECTOR is an UPPER_CASE class constant containing `[data-testid="ai-provider-configuration-card"]` — compliant per the one-hop check. No other hits.
